from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import json

for code in (\"533b23\", \"7d23f1\"):
    case = Path(code)
    actions = json.loads((case / \"actions.json\").read_text())
    observer = json.loads((case / \"observer.json\").read_text())
    calls = observer[\"executor_native_and_other_network_commands\"]
    assert all(any(op.get(\"command\") == call[\"command\"] and op.get(\"exit\") == call[\"shell_exit\"] for op in actions[\"operations\"]) for call in calls)
    rows = [row for call in calls for group in call[\"metadata_extracted_from_event\"] for row in group]
    print(code, len(rows), sorted(Counter((row[\"event\"], row[\"state\"]) for row in rows).items()), \"unique_names\", len({row[\"name\"] for row in rows}))
    print(\"observer\", [json.loads(readback[\"stdout\"]) for readback in observer[\"independent_public_readback_at_observation\"]])
    print(\"unparameterized_operations\", [op for op in actions[\"operations\"] if \"command\" not in op])
    print(\"changed\", actions[\"changed\"], observer[\"confirmed_on_neutral_copy\"])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import collections
import json
for case in sorted(path for path in Path('.').iterdir() if path.is_dir()):
    act = json.loads((case/'actions.json').read_text())
    obs = json.loads((case/'observer.json').read_text())
    print(case.name, 'handoff_equal', (case/'before/handoff.md').read_bytes() == (case/'after/handoff.md').read_bytes(), 'changed', act['changed'], 'inventory', obs['confirmed_on_neutral_copy'], 'guide', obs['executor_opened_local_skill'])
    for item in obs['executor_native_and_other_network_commands']:
        entry = item['metadata_extracted_from_event']
        if len(entry) == 1 and isinstance(entry[0], list):
            print('  checks', dict(collections.Counter((check['event'], check['state']) for check in entry[0])))
        print('  event', item['event_line'], 'exit', item['shell_exit'], 'grouped', item['grouped_shell'], item.get('github_response', item.get('cli_response', '')))
    for item in obs.get('web_tool_events_from_primary_record', []):
        print('  web', item['event_line'], item['url'])
PY"
